headline: TRITN's +50.00% surge and PRECHA's -28.57% decline lead an active start, while MK and RML carry the most notable volume alerts.
market_take: Coverage shows sharp dispersion, led by TRITN at +50.00% and GEL at +33.33%, while PRECHA fell -28.57% on volume 9.51 times normal. Property activity was broad, with EVER, JCK and MK higher but CI and TU-PF lower. There were 47 unusual-trading alerts, including high volume spikes in RML, NSL and MK; no filing was provided for the leading price movers.

sector_notes.note: TRITN rose +50.00% on volume 3.38 times normal, while STPI fell -6.25% on volume 3.12 times normal and had a 3.9σ volume alert. SOLAR gained +3.85% on volume 3.42 times normal, and TRC fell -6.06%.

PRECHA dropped -28.57% with volume 9.51 times normal, the heaviest turnover among the top movers, while CI fell -5.71% on volume 5.22 times normal. MK gained +5.08% on volume 6.36 times normal and a 5.2σ volume alert; EVER rose +20.00% but volume was only 0.04 times normal.

TU-PF fell -4.63% and opened with a -5.56% price gap, with volume 1.92 times normal. SSTRT, QHOP and LHRREIT triggered volume alerts, while TNPF disclosed an invitation to submit an offer to buy or lease an asset.
GEL rose +33.33% with volume 1.03 times normal, while DCON opened +6.67% and then moved -6.25% intraday. WINDOW and DCC filed reviewed third-quarter results.

NSL and SAUCE triggered volume alerts of 6.3σ and 4.0σ versus the 20-day average, while AQUA had a -10.00% open gap followed by an +11.11% intraday move. TU filed reviewed third-quarter results and board resolutions concerning the distribution of repurchased shares.
SMO fell -4.26% on volume 1.81 times normal; no unusual-trading alert or filing was provided.
